title: Symmetrize: detect the symmetry plane, clip, mirror
description: 'Should be able to make a mirror symmetrical mesh from the existing non-symmetrical meshes.' Three pieces: `detect_symmetry_plane` (PCA of vertex positions for the candidate planes, refined by reflective ICP: reflect, nearest-point, re-fit; outputs plane point + normal as vector ports), `clip_by_plane` (keep one half-space, split crossing triangles exactly on the plane so the boundary loop lies in the plane; optional cap), then the existing mirror_geometry with merge_distance to weld the loop. Attribute slots (UVs, labels, tags, bone weights) mirror onto the copy; bone names may take a side prefix (left_/right_) via a `side_prefix` input. Works on a HalfEdgeMesh at scan scale (CRAW-2 precondition).
definition-of-done: 1. An asymmetrically noised torus becomes mirror-symmetric within 1e-3 (max |p - reflect(p)| over sampled points) after detect -> clip -> mirror. 2. clip_by_plane produces a closed boundary loop in the plane and a manifold half. 3. mirror weld leaves no duplicate vertices or non-manifold edges (mesh-validate passes). 4. Slots survive with mirrored values; bone names prefixed when side_prefix is set. 5. Runs on a full crawfish scan in the mesh-viewer scene (screenshot before/after). 6. Build checkstyle-green.
testing-plan: 1. Unit: detect_symmetry_plane on a torus with a rotated known plane recovers normal within 0.5 degrees. 2. Unit: clip_by_plane on a cube at an oblique plane -> manifold half, boundary in plane. 3. Unit: symmetry residual on the noised torus. 4. run-scene mesh-viewer with a symmetrize .dsl on IMG_4109.glb; screenshot; `ixdar-cli mesh-validate`.
todos: clip_by_plane node with exact plane splitting in HalfEdgeMesh
Slot mirroring and bone side prefix in mirror_geometry
unknowns: Whether to keep the better-scanned half automatically (compare per-half texture sharpness / triangle quality) or leave the choice to a `keep_side` input
Whether the crawfish should be symmetric at all in the claws (real crawfish have asymmetric claws) -- per-label symmetry exclusion may be wanted
